segments.text:
V. 3.
To him the door-keeper openeth—Chriſt is conſidered as the Shepherd, ver. 11. As the door in the firſt and following Verſes. And as it is not unworthy of Chriſt, to be ſtiled the Door, by which both the Sheep and the true Paſtor enter, ſo neither is it unworthy of GOD the Father, to be ſtiled the Door-keeper. See Acts xiv. 27. Col. iv. 3. Rev. iii. 8. Acts xvi. 14. And the ſheep hear his voice—The Circumſtances that follow, exactly agree with the Cuſtoms of the ancient eaſtern Shepherds. They called their ſheep by name, w•nt before them, and the Sheep followed them. So real Chriſtians hear, liſten to, underſtand, and obey the Voice of a Shepherd whom Chriſt hath ſent. And He counteth them his own, dearer than any Friend or Brother; calleth, adviſes, directs each by name, and l••deth them out, in the Paths of Righteouſneſs, beſide the Waters of Comfort.
